context: A married couple plans an upcoming family vacation
purpose: Teach: 休暇/冗談/貴方/ウチ/仕掛け/カップル/やりとり/グルメ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ねえ貴方、今年の夏休暇はどこに行く？子どもたちもう待ちきれないって。
lines.en: Hey honey, where are we going for our summer vacation this year? The kids can't wait anymore.
lines.style: Warm wifely tone, gently raising a shared family planning topic.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: そうだなあ、ウチの家族はいつもバタバタだから、今回はゆっくりできる温泉宿がいいんじゃないか。
lines.en: Let me think, our family is always in a rush, so maybe a relaxing hot spring inn would be best this time.
lines.style: Thoughtful husband voice, slightly tired but genuinely caring.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 温泉もいいけど、せっかくならグルメも楽しめる町がいいわ。北陸とか、どう？
lines.en: Hot springs sound nice, but if we're going, I'd love a town where we can enjoy gourmet food too. How about Hokuriku?
lines.style: Enthusiastic, leaning into shared interests, suggesting a destination.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 北陸か。実は会社の同僚から、宿に面白い仕掛けがある露天風呂を聞いたんだ。
lines.en: Hokuriku, huh. Actually, a colleague at work told me about an outdoor bath with a clever gimmick at one of the inns.
lines.style: Slightly excited, sharing inside information with a hint of mystery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 仕掛け？まさか若いカップル向けの宿じゃないでしょうね、冗談でしょ？
lines.en: A gimmick? Don't tell me it's an inn for young couples only — you're joking, right?
lines.style: Playful suspicion, teasing her husband with mock alarm.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 冗談だよ、ちゃんと家族向けの宿だ。予約サイトとのやりとりも俺がやっておくから安心しろ。
lines.en: Just kidding, it's a proper family-friendly inn. I'll handle the back-and-forth with the booking site, so don't worry.
lines.style: Reassuring, slightly proud of taking responsibility for logistics.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 助かるわ。じゃあ私は子どもたちの服と、現地のグルメスポット調べておくね。
lines.en: That helps. Then I'll take care of the kids' clothes and look up the local gourmet spots ahead of time.
lines.style: Practical and warm, dividing tasks like a well-coordinated team.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 頼むよ。久しぶりの長い休暇だ、家族みんなで思いっきり楽しもうな。
lines.en: Please do. It's our first long vacation in a while — let's all enjoy it to the fullest as a family.
lines.style: Soft, sincere closing, full of quiet anticipation.
